entities.name: Christopher Columbus Harris
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christopher Columbus Harris was an American lawyer, banker, and Confederate Civil War veteran who represented Alabama's 8th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1914 to 1915.
